instruction: Reply to Priya that Thursday works, and hold Thursday 10am for the call.
final_text:
I replied to Priya and booked the call for Thursday at 10am.

- **Reply:** I sent it in her "Quick call this week?" thread. It says Thursday works, suggests 10:00–10:30am Pacific, and asks her to let you know if that time doesn't suit her.
- **Calendar:** "Call with Priya Shah – pilot scope" is on your calendar for Thursday, Oct 1, 10:00–10:30am, and Priya has been sent an invite. That time was free; it's right after your 9:30 standup. I made it 30 minutes because that's what she asked for.

input.title: Call with Priya Shah – pilot scope
input.description: 30-minute call to go over the pilot scope.

input.subject: Re: Quick call this week?
input.body:
Hi Priya,

Thursday works. How about 10:00–10:30am Pacific? I've sent a calendar invite for that time. If it doesn't suit you, just let me know.

Best,
Sam
